Constructor for PeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch

Source: R/class_PeakAnnotationLibraryMatch.R
PeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch.Rd

Thin wrapper around createPeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch(), the canonical user-facing constructor. See that function for full parameter documentation.

Usage

PeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch(
  library_matches,
  FT = data.frame(),
  adducts_df,
  neutral_loss_table,
  polarity = "positive",
  mz_threshold = 0.005,
  ppm = 30,
  nl_ppm = 5,
  rt_threshold = 3,
  rt_exp_threshold = 5,
  ppm_exp = 5,
  iso_threshold = 1.003355,
  max_charge = 3L,
  max_isotope = 4L
)

Arguments

library_matches

A list of spectral library match results (e.g. output of direct_match_MS1 or direct_match_MS2). Each element must contain:

  • Compound_name

  • Compound_M

  • Ion_type

  • Lib_group

  • Matched_features_to_peaks

  • Matched_features_mz

Optional (used when available):

  • Matched_features_rt

  • Matched_features_int

  • Precursor_mz

  • inner_cosine, outer_cosine, Match_peak_score

FT

data.frame. Full feature pool table (all features, not only library-matched ones). Required columns: feature_name, one of mzmed/mz. Optional: rtmed/rt, intensity column (maxo/into/intensity). Pass data.frame() to run Phase 1 only (no M-expansion).

adducts_df

data.frame. Adduct definition table with columns Ion.name, Ion.polarity, Ion.mass.

neutral_loss_table

data.frame. Neutral loss table with columns Accurate.Mass, Formula (or Neutral.Loss), Pos, Neg.

polarity

"positive" or "negative" (normalised internally to "pos" / "neg").

mz_threshold

Numeric. Absolute m/z tolerance in Da; acts as floor for all OR-condition ppm gates. Default 0.005.

ppm

Numeric. ppm gate for Phase 1 adduct matching. Effective tolerance is max(mz_threshold, mz * ppm * 1e-6). Controls confidence tier assignment: <=5 Confirmed, <=10 Probable, <=20 Tentative, <=30 Questionable, >30 rejected. Default 30.

nl_ppm

Numeric. ppm gate for neutral-loss matching in both phases. Default 5.

rt_threshold

Numeric. RT tolerance (seconds) for Phase 1 within-group NL matching. Default 3.

rt_exp_threshold

Numeric. RT window (seconds) around the compound reference RT for Phase 2 pool search. Default 5.

ppm_exp

Numeric. ppm gate for Phase 2 adduct search. Default 5.

iso_threshold

Numeric. Isotope mass delta (12C/13C spacing). Default 1.003355.

max_charge

Integer. Maximum charge state for isotope detection. Default 3L.

max_isotope

Integer. Maximum isotope peaks per charge state. Default 4L.

Value

A PeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch object.

See also

createPeakAnnotationFromLibraryMatch()
